newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Reinsurance in A$60.9 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Reinsurance in A$60.9 mln placement.

text.p: Reinsurance Australia Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it would establish a specialist catastrophe insurance vehicle capitalised at A$125 million.
It said the new vehicle would be partly funded by a private placement of 15 million shares to existing institutional investors at A$4.06 per share to raise A$60.9 million.
Reinsurance said the specialist subsidiary's capital would also be provided by the parent company's retained earnings.
It said the share placement had been fully underwritten by brokerage firm BZW Australia Ltd. Reinsurance shares ended one cent lower at A$4.29 on Tuesday.

The new subsidiary would be based on Monaco and begin operations in early December 1996, allowing it to write business in the 1997 international renewal season. Reinsurance said the formation of the unit represented the company's next step in its development as a major international reinsurer.
